title: Smartsheet pricing - No free plan since 2025, $9-$32 per user/month paid tiers
clean_text: Smartsheet discontinued its limited free plan in 2025 and now offers only a 30-day free trial. Paid tiers (annual billing) start with Pro at $9/user/month for up to 10 users, and Business at a reported $19-$32/user/month for unlimited users and storage depending on source; Enterprise is custom-priced as of March 2026 with unlimited usage and advanced security controls. Premium add-on applications -- Dynamic View, Control Center, DataMesh, Bridge, and WorkApps -- are priced separately and can add 20-50% to total contract value.
